response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and web software engineer with a strong background in TypeScript, Node.js, and general software craftsmanship, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role focused on hardware-software co-design for AI chips.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years)
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
Career path is almost entirely web/mobile/backend software, not hardware/performance engineering for accelerators

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
